name: Shaaph
title: Descendants of Shaaph in the Tribe of Benjamin
summary: Shaaph (also known as Shaaph) is a person mentioned in the biblical genealogies in 1 Chronicles. He is listed as a son of Jahdai and belonged to the descendants of Caleb. He is a lesser-known biblical figure who appears mainly in genealogical lists.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Caleb
keyEvents.description: Shaaph is listed as one of the sons of Jahdai in the genealogy of Caleb's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Caleb
keyEvents.description: Shaaph is part of the larger genealogical list describing Caleb's descendants and their settlements in the region of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Another Shaaph mentioned as a son of Caleb
keyEvents.description: Another person named Shaaph is also mentioned as a son of Caleb's concubine Maakah, and he became the father of Madmannah.

keyEvents.title: The significance of genealogies
keyEvents.description: The genealogies in 1 Chronicles served to preserve tribal identity and inheritance rights in Israel, which was especially important after the exile.
